name: EIF Grants (seed and project grants)
summary: Namibian national fund giving seed grants and project grants to civil society, private sector and individuals for community natural resource management, biodiversity and land use projects.

amount.note: Project grants; seed grants are up to N$10,000

applicant_types.quote: We invite applications from: - Civil society and institutions - Private sector - Individuals

geography.quote: The EIF provides such grants to civil society organizations, private sector and individuals within Namibia

access.quote: We invite applications from: - Civil society and institutions - Private sector - Individuals

amount.quote: These are the normal type of grants intended for full project implementation and that range between N$ 10,000 and N$ 500,000.
